subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: Drones Over Cities
description: A quick, practical guide to Drones Over Cities.

hook.text: A drone hovers 10,000 feet above a city, recording every person and vehicle for hours at a time.

buildup.text: Wide-area surveillance drones capture entire cities in a single frame, tracking all movement.

discovery.text: The technology was developed for battlefields in Iraq. Now it's being tested over American cities.

twist.text: Unlike cameras on poles, drones can follow you from your home to your office to your doctor.

climax.text: Drones give governments the ability to rewind time and trace anyone's movements after the fact.

quiz.question: Where was wide-area drone surveillance originally developed?
